messages:
maria: Quick heads up — embedding endpoints are degraded for a subset of requests. Need marketing help: statuspage wording, timing for customer email, and inbound lead gating plan. Can we sync here and decide?

lucas: Current state: investigating -> identified. Root cause looks like a KV-cache regression on the new runtime. Teams are running a mitigative rollout now. ETA rough 45–60m. Will post updates.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-embeddings transitioned to identified by lucas.

priya: For comms segmentation: recommend immediate email to SLA customers + targeted DM to customers with active jobs. General statuspage update for all. Avoid-wide marketing blast until we have a stable recovery.

sam: Sales ask: please pause auto-SFDC lead notifications and route any incoming trial signups/contacts to a shared mailbox or #incident-inbound for 2 hours. We don't want reps chasing noisy spikes.

alex: Support note: we'll pin an in-product banner pointing to statuspage and use canned replies in support. Draft status copy below — feel free to edit.

alex: ```
We are currently experiencing degraded performance for embedding and similarity endpoints. Impact: some requests may return slower or reduced-quality embeddings. Our engineering team is actively investigating and applying mitigations.
Next update: in 30 minutes. If you are an enterprise customer or have time-sensitive workloads, please contact support@redwood.com and mention your account ID.
```

maria: Love this — two edits: add a brief "what we're doing" line and call out webinar registrants. Proposed tweak: 

maria: ```
What we're doing: rolling back the recent KV-cache optimization and routing traffic to the stable runtime while we validate metrics.
```

maria: For webinar at 15:00 PT — recommend postponing live demo and sending a short registrant update (no more than 1 sentence + link to statuspage). Priya, can you draft?

priya: Draft registrant note: "We're pausing today's live demo due to a platform incident affecting embeddings. We'll share a new time within 48 hours — in the meantime you can follow status updates at <https://status.redwood.com>." Short and to the point.

sam: Confirming routing: please disable the SFDC webhook for new signups and forward them to incident-inbound@redwood.com. I'll have SDRs monitor #incident-inbound but not proactively reach out until we clear the incident.

lucas: Ops can aim to publish the first public status update in ~25 minutes. We'll confirm recovery window after rollback metrics trend.

alex: I'll prepare the canned support snippet and a short KB update link. Also recommend we suppress outbound paid ads until we close the incident.

maria: Agreed — hold paid social/email paid channels. Publish timeline: statuspage in 25m, enterprise email in 45–60m after confirm. Webinar registrants note now (send within 10m).

sam: :thumbsup: I'll pause SFDC webhook and confirm once done.

incident-bot: SFDC webhook disabled by automation (webhook-manager).

priya: One more ask — for enterprise customers on Dedicated, we should route their inbound to a priority queue and include "incident" tag so success can escalate.

alex: Done — canned replies include priority routing instructions and link to #incident-inbound.

maria: Okay team, thanks. I'll push the statuspage copy in 25m and send the registrant update now. Please post confirmations here when actions are complete. :pray:
